newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds untraded due to U.S. mkt holiday.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds untraded due to U.S. mkt holiday.

text.p: Argentine bonds did not trade Monday because the U.S. Treasury market was closed for the President's Day holiday.
"There is nothing going on today," said a trader at a local bank.
No trades in local bonds were recorded on screens by late morning Monday.
Argentina's FRB due 2005, traded abroad, was 1/4 lower at 91-1/2.
On Friday, the locally traded dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 due 2001 was unchanged at 126.50.
